name: How long does it typically take to install a kitchen island?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a kitchen island?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical duration for kitchen island installation varies depending on the project's scope. A straightforward, pre-fabricated island installation without utility modifications might take a few days. However, custom designs, especially those requiring new electrical outlets, plumbing for a sink, or gas lines for a cooktop, can extend the timeline to several weeks due to the need for multiple trades and inspections. We coordinate all necessary sub-contractors to streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from a few days for simple islands to several weeks for custom designs with utility modifications, which require coordination of trades and inspections.
